# Widget

> **File:** `config/Widget.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Reader for the Widget section: sizing for panels, cards, popouts and controls. Bars size their own widgets (Bar.enrichBarConfig).

### Properties

- `height` (readonly int)
- `padding` (readonly int)
- `spacing` (readonly int)
- `radius` (readonly int): Corners of what sits inside something (cards, controls, rows, bar widgets); outer edges use Appearance.borderRadius
